editorial.blurb: Chef Sasaki's intimate omakase counter serves pristine, Japan-imported fish with the kind of care that transports you straight to Tokyo.
editorial.insiderTip: Sit at the sushi bar to watch Chef Sasaki work his magic and get real-time explanations of each piece; the $79 nigiri omakase is a steal, and the $45 sake pairing elevates the experience beautifully.
